newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia drops proceedings against rights activist.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia drops proceedings against rights activist.

text.p: A Tunisian prosecutor has dropped judicial proceedings against activist Salah Zeghidi who was questioned over remarks he made at a seminar abroad, the Tunisian League for the Defence of Human Rights (LTDH) said on Thursday.
"The League takes note of the positive prosecutor's decision to drop the accusation," it said in a statement.
Zeghidi, vice-president of LTDH, had been questioned by the prosecutor on December 17 on whether he spread "false information" during a human rights seminar organised earlier this month in Brussels.
